name: Melio
summary: Bill payments for small businesses by bank transfer or card, syncing with your accounting tools. Card payments carry a flat 2.9%, which only pays off when you are deliberately floating cash.
best_for: small businesses that want to pay bills by bank transfer or card and get paid, starting free with no subscription
skip_if: you already run AP through robust accounting software with bill-pay built in — a second tool adds little
honest_knock: The free plan is genuinely useful for low bill volume, but the value case narrows as you scale into paid tiers — and the 2.9% card fee only makes sense when you're deliberately floating cash on a card for rewards or timing.

pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-08-17 on their own pricing page) A free Go plan, $0 forever, with 5 free ACH payments a month and $0.50 for each one after that. Core is $25/mo, or $20 billed annually, with 20 free ACH a month; Boost $55/mo, or $44 annually, with 50 free ACH; Unlimited $80/mo. The detail our earlier note missed: every paid plan adds $10 a month per additional user, or $8 on annual billing, so a three-person finance team on Core is $45 a month rather than $25. Card payments carry a flat 2.9% fee and check and wire payments have their own charges. There is a 30-day trial.
